db:select.doc:name: Select By ID
db:select.db:sql: SELECT account_id, plan_type, plan_name, balance, settled_balance, vested_balance, available_for_withdrawal, currency, status, tax_year FROM account_summary WHERE customer_id = :customerId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (item) -> { account_id: item.account_id, plan_type: item.plan_type, plan_name: item.plan_name, balance: item.balance, settled_balance: item.settled_balance, vested_balance: item.vested_balance, available_for_withdrawal: item.available_for_withdrawal, currency: item.currency, status: item.status, tax_year: item.tax_year }

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, Customer_ID__c, First_Name__c, Last_Name__c, Email__c, Phone__c, Date_of_Birth__c, SSN_Last_4__c, Address_Line_1__c, City__c, State__c, Postal_Code__c, Status__c, External_Id__c, OwnerId, CreatedById, LastModifiedById FROM Customer_Profile__c WHERE Customer_ID__c = ':customerId'

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (item) -> { CustomerID: item.Customer_ID__c, FullName: (item.First_Name__c default"") ++ " " ++ (item.Last_Name__c default""), Email: item.Email__c, Phone: item.Phone__c, DOB: item.Date_of_Birth__c, SSNLast4: item.SSN_Last_4__c, AddressLine1: item.Address_Line_1__c, City: item.City__c, State: item.State__c, PostalCode: item.Postal_Code__c, Status: item.Status__c }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "The customer is inactive or status is unrecognized", "customerStatus": payload[0].Status__c }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Account Summary
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO account_summary ( account_id, customer_id, plan_type, plan_name, balance, settled_balance, vested_balance, available_for_withdrawal, currency, status, tax_year ) VALUES ( :account_id, :customer_id, :plan_type, :plan_name, :balance, :settled_balance, :vested_balance, :available_for_withdrawal, :currency, :status, :tax_year )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ account_id: payload.account_id, customer_id: payload.customer_id, plan_type: payload.plan_type, plan_name: payload.plan_name, balance: payload.balance, settled_balance: payload.settled_balance, vested_balance: payload.vested_balance, available_for_withdrawal: payload.available_for_withdrawal, currency: payload.currency, status: payload.status, tax_year: payload.tax_year }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "new record inserted", payload: "newRecord" }
